mkt_hero_title: Data-driven coaching for trail, ultra & endurance athletes
mkt_hero_subtitle: OpenAthlete combines science, personalization, and field experience to optimize your performance: race planning, nutrition strategy, and precise analysis for race day.
mkt_home_why_point1: Integrated view: training load, terrain, elevation, pacing
mkt_home_value_p1: Months of preparation can unravel on race day due to pacing or fueling errors.
mkt_home_value_p2: OpenAthlete turns preparation into performance with a clear, data-backed race plan and nutrition strategy—so you execute with confidence from start to finish.
mkt_services_intro: Race plans, nutrition strategy, structured training, personalized coaching.
mkt_services_intro_strong_title: Services that turn training into performance
mkt_services_intro_strong_text: Every plan is built from your data and the race data. No generic templates—everything is calculated for your profile, your goal, and real conditions.
mkt_service_raceplan_desc: Segmented pacing, elevation profiling & time targets.
mkt_service_raceplan_long: Segment-by-segment breakdown, final time estimate, km-by-km pacing targets, adapted to elevation and weather.
mkt_service_raceplan_benefit1: Know where to push and where to save energy.
mkt_service_raceplan_benefit2: Less stress on the start line—you already know your race scenario.
mkt_service_nutrition_desc: Custom fueling plan per aid station & conditions.
mkt_service_nutrition_long: Precise fueling plan: carbohydrate quantity, electrolytes, and hydration per aid station. Adapted to duration, heat, and your habits.
mkt_service_coaching_desc: Progressive monitoring with analysis and personalized adjustments.
mkt_service_coaching_long: Analysis of your training history, multi-week monitoring, and progressive adjustments. Focus on load, recovery, and race-specific preparation.
mkt_service_coaching_benefit1: Clear understanding of your strengths and weaknesses.
mkt_method_step1_desc: Your data, your goal, and the race profile.
mkt_method_step2_desc: Pacing, nutrition, and gear adapted to you.
mkt_method_step3_desc: Adjustments based on your progress and conditions.
mkt_method_step4_desc: On race day, you know exactly when to push, hike, or fuel.
mkt_unique_point3: Proven in the field through ultra experience.
mkt_about_intro: OpenAthlete was born from a simple belief: hard training should never be wasted by a poor race-day strategy. Combining data science and field experience, we build precise plans that turn preparation into measurable performance.
mkt_about_founder_b2: Passionate about data science applied to sport
mkt_about_founder_quote: My goal is to make elite methods accessible to dedicated amateurs. Every athlete—whatever their level—deserves a clear, personalized strategy.
mkt_about_values_science: Science — load, recovery and performance models grounded in research.
mkt_about_values_personal: Personalization — every context is unique: your profile, your goal, your race.
mkt_about_values_field: Field reality — elevation, weather, fueling and pacing are integrated from the start.
mkt_about_vision_text: Whether you’re aiming for marginal gains at the elite level or finishing your first ultra, OpenAthlete gives you the tools to reach your potential.
